title: Sliding Window Maximum
summary: Report the maximum of every window of size k as it slides across an array.

tests.explain: The window covers the whole array.

hints: Scanning each window for its maximum costs O(k), for O(n * k) in total. You need the maximum to update cheaply as the window moves by one position.

When a new value arrives, any earlier value in the window that is smaller can never be the maximum again: the new one is larger and stays in the window longer. So you can throw those earlier values away.

Keep a deque of indices whose values are in decreasing order. Before pushing index i, pop from the back while nums[back] <= nums[i]. Pop from the front when its index is <= i - k. Once i >= k - 1, the front of the deque is the window maximum.

complexity.time: O(n): every index is pushed once and popped at most once
